author: claude
summary: Voice-variant tagging + IA redesign plan (~/.claude/plans/audiobook-factory/voice-variant-tagging-and-ia/), tasks 001-004 of 13: restored an orphaned icon image-generation-prompt affordance, fixed pill-primitive token hygiene, and added the backend performance_tags read/write path (a new per-variant, user-extensible tag field distinct from the existing character-level controlled tone/pace taxonomy). Task 005 (a new default-variant write endpoint, since none currently exists) is in flight against the same backend files task 004 touched.

files.change: Added optional metadata prop and a new icon-only 'copy icon generation prompt' button (native title tooltip on hover/focus, clipboard-copy on click, visible error on a rejected clipboard write instead of a silent swallow). Restores a previously-built-then-orphaned feature (buildIconPrompt(), unmodified) rather than rebuilding it.
Threads voice metadata into IconUpload so the new copy-prompt button can build its prompt.
Deleted -- confirmed zero live imports (orphaned by an earlier tab-consolidation rework); its old text-button UI was superseded by the new icon-only affordance in IconUpload.tsx, not re-mounted.

Token-hygiene fix: hardcoded padding/fontSize/gap values on VoicePill, VoicePillRow's +N/collapse buttons, and UntaggedBadge replaced with --space-*/--type-* tokens (pixel-identical result). Also fixed the +N/collapse buttons' aria-expanded to reflect real state instead of being hardcoded false/absent.
Added 'performance_tags' to the per-variant settings write endpoint's allowlist (previously rejected any key outside an engine-derived allowlist).

Added performance_tags: [] to get_speaker_settings()'s default response dict (surfaces the field once present in profile.json); added server-side normalization (strip/lowercase/hyphenate + de-dupe) for performance_tags in update_speaker_settings, placed after the existing variant-name-resolution hazard-guard code without disturbing it.

Added performance_tags to list_speaker_profiles()'s per-profile response dict, sourced from the same get_speaker_settings() call already used for other fields -- keeps this surface in agreement with the per-variant settings read path.

spec_version bumped 1.9.0 -> 1.11.0 across two changelog rows: performance_tags added to Section 4.2's variant profile.json field table (task 004); Section 11.1's 'Copy icon prompt' entry corrected from claiming catalog-card scope to Voice-Lab-only, and stale VoiceIconControls references in Section 11's shipped-status block updated to point at IconUpload.tsx/iconPrompt.ts (task 001).

flow_impact: voice-variant-tagging-and-ia plan: the performance_tags data model is now readable/writable end-to-end on the backend (tasks 004 done; task 005's default-variant endpoint in flight against the same files). No frontend consumption yet -- that's tasks 006/007 (TagAutocompleteInput + wiring into VariantEditor), unblocked now that task 003's pill-token-hygiene fix has landed.
